remarks: Welcome to 35 Weiss Street — a rare opportunity in Buffalo's Kaisertown neighborhood to create a property tailored entirely to your needs and lifestyle. This isn't a standard renovation. The owner is one of Buffalo's most respected licensed contractors, offering a truly unique opportunity to customize a complete, high-quality remodel and take possession of a finished, move-in-ready home at closing. The possibilities are nearly endless. The property can be configured as a spacious two-family home featuring two 2-bedroom, 1-bath units, with the potential to create two 3-bedroom, 1-bath units for increased rental income and flexibility. Looking for a single-family residence? The layout also accommodates a generous 6-bedroom home, or up to 7 bedrooms with a finished attic, making it ideal for large families, multi-generational living, home offices, fitness spaces, guest suites, and more. Every aspect of the renovation can be designed around your personal taste. Choose your flooring, cabinetry, countertops, backsplash, tile selections, fixtures, lighting, paint colors, trim details, and finishes throughout. This is your chance to enjoy the benefits of a custom-built home without the challenges of managing a renovation yourself. Beyond the cosmetic selections, the home will undergo extensive modernization, including new electrical, plumbing, HVAC, insulation, drywall, flooring, kitchens, bathrooms, doors, trim, lighting, and other major system and component updates. The result is a property that combines classic Buffalo character with the comfort, efficiency, and reliability of modern construction. No unfinished projects. No renovation headaches. No surprises after closing. Just a beautifully finished home or investment property built around your vision and delivered move-in ready. Whether you're seeking an income-producing two-family property or a spacious single-family residence, 35 Weiss Street offers a level of customization and flexibility rarely found in today's market. The price is NEGOTIABLE and is dependent on how the buyers prefer the work to be done.
